text:
jen_support: FYI customer report — exported CSV only has the header row and then thousands of empty-looking rows (just commas). They say Excel shows blank rows after header; the file download size is 0 bytes locally but the presigned URL GET returns 200. Happens when they toggle "Expand event metadata" on in the analytics UI. Export ID: export_0a1b2c. Link pasted (presigned): https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood-exports/export_0a1b2c?X-Amz-...

export-bot: export job queued: export_0a1b2c (status: started) :gear:

mike_sre: can you paste the curl -I output for the presigned url? need to see headers (Content-Length etc). also which customer/org is this?

jen_support: customer: acme-marketing (acct: acc_789). here's what support saw:
```
$ curl -I "https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood-exports/export_0a1b2c?X-Amz-..."
HTTP/2 200
content-type: application/octet-stream
content-length: 16777216
x-amz-request-id: 123456789
accept-ranges: bytes
```
When they actually download with the browser it saves a 0-byte file. We tried `curl -O` and got a 0 byte file as well.

mike_sre: interesting. headers say 16MB but body zero. that points to either the S3 object is empty but metadata incorrect, or our streaming upload to S3 reported a size but failed to write chunks. lucas, any recent changes to export streaming?

lucas_eng: noted. last runtime change was a small refactor in the CSV stream writer (chunked streaming) to support incremental quoting for nested JSON fields (PR #5421). Could be a bug where an exception during streaming aborts the upload but the multipart/complete still runs leaving metadata intact. do we have logs for export_0a1b2c from export-worker?

jen_support: attaching worker logs excerpt from the customer's run (sanitized):
```
2026-11-05T09:12:34Z export-worker[pid:2045] start export export_0a1b2c org=acc_789
2026-11-05T09:12:35Z export-worker chunker: writing header\n
2026-11-05T09:12:36Z export-worker row-processor: row 1 ok
2026-11-05T09:12:36Z export-worker row-processor: row 2 ok
2026-11-05T09:12:36Z export-worker row-processor: row 3 exception JSONFieldError: unexpected CRLF in field
2026-11-05T09:12:36Z export-worker error: uncaught exception, aborting upload, cleaning tmp parts
2026-11-05T09:12:36Z export-worker multipart-upload: completed upload (ETag set) size=16777216
2026-11-05T09:12:36Z export-worker result: export failed, status=partial
```

anita_analytics: pattern I saw in metrics — these reports only appear for long-ish date ranges (> 90 days) and when "Expand event metadata" is enabled. that option expands nested JSON columns which can contain unescaped CR/LF in some third-party payloads.

lucas_eng: that JSONFieldError is our new validator throwing on raw CRLF inside string fields. looks like we raise when encountering CRLF and then don't handle the exception path correctly during streaming — the worker still issues multipart-complete with an empty body. I can repro locally by streaming rows containing `\r\n` inside a nested field and forcing an exception mid-stream.

olivia_product: is this customer-facing yet? priority?

jen_support: customer is blocked — they export weekly reports via CSV and can't get data. Requested ETA and a workaround.

mike_sre: short-term workaround: advise the customer to uncheck "Expand event metadata" or reduce the date range. also provide API endpoint to export as jsonl (non-streamed) `GET /api/v1/exports/:id?format=jsonl` — that returns a stable download.

lucas_eng: plan: patch the exporter to catch per-row exceptions, write a placeholder row (or escape CRLF), and ensure multipart upload is aborted cleanly without issuing complete if body is empty. I'll open a hotfix branch and push a fix to eng-runtime.

lucas_eng: assigning to eng-runtime, will target a hotfix release in the next 2 hours. PR will include unit test reproducing CRLF in nested JSON and a safe-fail path.

jen_support: please add repro steps I can pass to customer.

lucas_eng: repro steps:
1. Create a dataset with an event containing nested field `{"meta":"line1\r\nline2"}`
2. In analytics UI enable "Expand event metadata" and select 6mo date range
3. Trigger CSV export -> observe presigned url returns 200 with Content-Length > 0 but download is 0 bytes or file only contains header

mike_sre: i'll also add a temporary alert for failed-export-worker exceptions so we catch this quicker.

jen_support: thanks all — I'll tell the customer the workaround and that eng is pushing a hotfix. Will update when they confirm that unchecking the toggle works. :thumbsup:

export-bot: export job update: export_0a1b2c -> failed (partial) :warning:

olivia_product: after hotfix, we should add an analytics UX note about nested fields and CSV stability for large ranges. might be a docs task.

jen_support: noted. I'll file a docs request and add to the support KB: "If CSV export returns empty file when expanding metadata, try jsonl or reduce range"

lucas_eng: pushed the hotfix branch, running CI now. will post PR link when green.

jen_support: awesome — keep me posted and ping when PR merged so I can close the support ticket.
